name: Set 10: The Masters Grand Finale
description: Springbok Hall of Fame, Classic Rock Titans, Master Steaks & World Frontiers

questions.q: How many hours are there in three full days?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: 3 x 24 = 72 hours.

questions.q: What is the common term in South African slang for a pickup truck?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: A bakkie: South Africa's favorite vehicle.

questions.q: What color is the center circle in the Japanese national flag?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: A red disc representing the rising sun on a white field.

questions.q: In golf, what is the term for a score of one over par on a single hole?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: One over par is a bogey.

questions.q: Which fruit is famous for having its seeds on the outside of its skin?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: Strawberries carry roughly 200 seed-like achenes on the outer skin.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Greece?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: Athens.

questions.q: How many players are on the field for one team during an Australian Rules Football match?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: 18 players on the field per team in Aussie Rules (AFL).

questions.q: What popular South African tea is caffeine-free and made from the leaves of the indigenous Aspalathus linearis plant in the Cederberg?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: Rooibos (red bush tea), indigenous to the Cederberg mountains.

questions.q: What is the currency of Mexico?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: Mexican Peso ($).

questions.q: In a game of pub darts, what is the value of the green outer bullseye ring?
questions.round: Round 1 · Ultimate Bar Warm-Up
questions.fact: Outer green bull = 25 points; inner red bull = 50 points.

questions.q: Which beloved Springbok scrumhalf scored 38 test tries in 89 appearances, famously tackling Jonah Lomu in the 1995 final?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: Joost van der Westhuizen: World Rugby Hall of Fame legend.

questions.q: Who is the only Springbok prop forward to win two Rugby World Cups twelve years apart, winning in both 1995 and 2007?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: Jacobus Petrus 'Os' du Randt: a giant of South African rugby.

questions.q: Which Springbok flanker won the World Rugby Player of the Year award in 2019 after devastating performances in Japan?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: Pieter-Steph du Toit: 'The Malmesbury Missile'.

questions.q: What South African scrumhalf became an internet sensation for his blond locks, South African flag speedo, and fearless confrontation with giant locks?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: Faf de Klerk, celebrated double World Cup winning scrumhalf.

questions.q: Who was the Springbok captain when South Africa won their second World Cup in Paris in 2007?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: John Smit captained the Springboks in a record 83 test matches.

questions.q: Which South African winger was named World Rugby Breakthrough Player of the Year in 2018, famous for his stepping and sidestep?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: Aphiwe Dyantyi won the award in 2018 after scoring 6 tries in his debut season.

questions.q: Which legendary Springbok flyhalf was known as 'The King' and scored all 27 points in a single match against the All Blacks in 1999?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: Jannie de Beer kicked a world record five drop goals against England in the 1999 World Cup quarter-final.

questions.q: Which iconic lock forward from the Northern Transvaal was famous for kicking 50-meter penalties with a straight toe-poke style and also playing flank and lock?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: Frik du Preez: named South Africa's rugby player of the 20th century.

questions.q: In rugby union, what is the maximum number of substitutions allowed from the bench in a modern test match?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: 8 players on the bench (the famous Springbok 'Bomb Squad').

questions.q: At which stadium in Yokohama, Japan did the Springboks defeat England 32-12 to win the 2019 Rugby World Cup?
questions.round: Round 2 · Springbok Legends & Rugby Hall of Fame
questions.fact: International Stadium Yokohama on 2 November 2019.

questions.q: Which British rock band released the 1973 progressive rock masterpiece The Dark Side of the Moon?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: Spent over 950 weeks on the US Billboard 200 chart.

questions.q: Which British rock band fronted by Mark Knopfler had massive 1985 hits with 'Money for Nothing' and 'Sultans of Swing'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: Their album Brothers in Arms was one of the first CD releases to sell over a million copies.

questions.q: Who released the hit 1971 folk-rock song 'American Pie' recounting 'the day the music died'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: Refers to the 1959 plane crash that killed Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and the Big Bopper.

questions.q: Which Anglo-American rock band released the legendary 1977 album Rumours featuring 'Go Your Own Way' and 'Dreams'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: Stevie Nicks, Lindsey Buckingham, Mick Fleetwood, Christine McVie, and John McVie.

questions.q: Which British singer-songwriter composed the musical score and songs for Disney's 1994 animated movie The Lion King, including 'Can You Feel the Love Tonight'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: Elton John (music) with lyrics by Tim Rice.

questions.q: In the hit song 'Hotel California' by the Eagles, what is the famous final line of the chorus?
answers: You can check out any time you like, but you can never leave
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: 'You can check out any time you like, but you can never leave!'

questions.q: What British heavy metal band fronted by Bruce Dickinson is famous for mascot Eddie and anthems like 'The Trooper' and 'Run to the Hills'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: Iron Maiden, formed in East London in 1975 by Steve Harris.

questions.q: Which South African female singer achieved international stardom in the 1980s with hits like 'Special Star' or collaborated with Sipho Mabuse on 'Burn Out'?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: PJ Powers ('Thandeka') fronted Hotline with hits like 'Jabulani'.

questions.q: Which American band featured Kurt Cobain, Krist Novoselic, and Dave Grohl?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: Pioneered the worldwide grunge explosion.

questions.q: Which British rock icon released 'Space Oddity' in 1969 introducing the astronaut Major Tom?
questions.round: Round 3 · Classic Rock, Pop & Soundtrack Icons
questions.fact: David Bowie's breakthrough single released days before Apollo 11 moon landing.

questions.q: What is the culinary term for aging beef in a temperature- and humidity-controlled room for several weeks to intensify flavor and tenderize the meat?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: Dry aging allows natural enzymes to break down muscle fibers while moisture evaporates, concentrating beef flavor.

questions.q: What is the famous South African dry white wine grape variety that is locally known as 'Steen'?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: South Africa has more Chenin Blanc planted than any other country in the world.

questions.q: What cut of steak is a thick cut of sirloin or ribeye served on a long, Frenched rib bone resembling a native axe?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: A bone-in ribeye with at least 12-15 cm of intact rib bone.

questions.q: What famous brand of South African potstill brandy won the Worldwide Best Brandy trophy multiple times at the International Wine & Spirit Competition?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: KWV's potstill brandies from Paarl have consistently swept global awards.

questions.q: What is the French culinary term for finely minced raw beef or game seasoned with capers, shallots, Worcestershire sauce, and topped with a raw egg yolk?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: Steak Tartare: classic bistro fare.

questions.q: Which South African coastal town is renowned for its annual Crayfish (West Coast Rock Lobster) Festival and open-air beach strandkombuis restaurants?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: Lamberts Bay and Paternoster are the heartland of West Coast seafood.

questions.q: What is the sweet fortified Portuguese wine from the Douro Valley that is traditionally aged in wooden casks and served as a digestif?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: Tawny or Ruby Port, often paired with blue cheese.

questions.q: What popular South African sweet confection consists of shredded coconut baked in caramelized brown sugar and rolled into patties?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: Traditional South African coconut ice or klapperys.

questions.q: What is the main type of wood traditionally used in barrels to age fine whiskey and red wine?
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: French and American white oak impart vanilla, tannin, and spice notes.

questions.q: In braai culture, what is the best way to test whether your coals are at the perfect medium-heat for chops and boerewors?
answers: If the grid turns glowing red
Hold your open palm about 10 cm above the grid: you can comfortably hold it for 5-7 seconds
Pour a cup of water over the coals
questions.round: Round 4 · The Ultimate Feast & Beverage Masterclass
questions.fact: The classic hand test: 5-7 seconds indicates medium heat; 3-4 seconds is high heat.

questions.q: Which South African mountain pass connects Oudtshoorn in the Klein Karoo to Prince Albert in the Great Karoo, engineered by Thomas Bain in the 1880s?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: The Swartberg Pass: a national monument and masterpiece of 19th-century dry-stone walling.

questions.q: What is the largest country in the world by total land area?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: Covering over 17 million square kilometers across two continents.

questions.q: In which city is the famous Sydney Opera House located?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: Designed by Danish architect Jørn Utzon on Bennelong Point in Sydney Harbour.

questions.q: What massive astronomical radio telescope array located in the Karoo near Carnarvon is part of the international Square Kilometre Array (SKA)?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: MeerKAT consists of 64 dish antennas peering deep into the early universe.

questions.q: What is the highest mountain peak in North America, located in the Alaska Range?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: Stands 6,190 meters above sea level.

questions.q: Which canal connects the Atlantic Ocean and the Pacific Ocean across Central America, saving ships an 8,000-mile detour around Cape Horn?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: Opened in August 1914; features a series of gravity-fed water locks.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Argentina?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: Buenos Aires: situated on the western shore of the Río de la Plata.

questions.q: What international laboratory near Geneva, Switzerland houses the 27-kilometer Large Hadron Collider particle accelerator?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: The European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN), birthplace of the World Wide Web.

questions.q: Which South African national park in the Eastern Cape was proclaimed in 1931 to save the remaining eleven Eastern Cape elephants from extinction?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: Now home to over 600 elephants, lions, buffalo, and black rhino.

questions.q: What is the official language of Brazil?
questions.round: Round 5 · Global Frontiers & Epic Discoveries
questions.fact: Brazil is the only Portuguese-speaking country in the Americas.

questions.q: How many total dish antennas make up the MeerKAT radio telescope array in the Northern Cape?
questions.round: Sudden-Death Tie-Breakers
questions.fact: 64 interconnected dish antennas.

questions.q: In what calendar year did the Swartberg Pass officially open to traffic?
questions.round: Sudden-Death Tie-Breakers
questions.fact: Opened on 10 January 1888.

questions.q: How many test tries did Joost van der Westhuizen score in his international rugby career for the Springboks?
questions.round: Sudden-Death Tie-Breakers
questions.fact: 38 tries in 89 test matches.
